title: FX Brief — 31 Aug 2026
intro:
Broad dollar strength dominates as USD gains across all majors amid risk-off sentiment and rising Treasury yields during thin Asian trade.
💪 CURRENCY RANKING
1. USD +0.46% — Safe-haven flows and yield support driving broad-based strength across all pairs
2. CHF +0.12% — Defensive bid as European risk aversion supports Swiss franc despite dollar dominance
3. JPY -0.24% — Underperforming despite risk-off as USD/JPY climbs toward 160.00 resistance level
4. CAD -0.37% — Oil weakness and broad USD strength pressure loonie despite commodity stability
5. GBP -0.57% — Sterling slides on Brexit concerns and dovish BoE repricing ahead of key data
6. EUR -0.59% — Euro weakness intensifies on ECB easing expectations and weak German manufacturing data
7. AUD -0.60% — China growth concerns and risk-off sentiment weigh on aussie despite firm iron ore
8. NZD -0.73% — Worst performer as dovish RBNZ expectations combine with broad risk aversion
